nodes.label: NestJS
nodes.rationale: API in apps/backend. Feature code lives in src/modules/<feature>. Controllers own HTTP and call services; services own business logic and persistence. Do not call one controller from another. Register feature modules in src/app.module.ts. Routes are the global /api prefix plus controller and method paths; do not silently move existing paths. Use .js suffixes on relative imports where neighbors do. Preserve status codes, response shapes, and 405 handlers. Never print or commit .env values. When verifying, run the narrowest test and do not send real SMS, payments, or Stellar transactions unless asked. This skill is not for mobile or Soroban contract work.

nodes.label: Express
nodes.rationale: HTTP platform the Nest app is created on in src/main.ts. Middleware is applied there, in order, before bootstrap adds the global prefix and pipes.

nodes.label: ValidationPipe
nodes.rationale: Strict global pipe configured in src/bootstrap.ts. It transforms values, does not silently drop unknown fields, and rejects non-whitelisted fields. Validate requests with DTOs through this pipe.

nodes.label: Swagger
nodes.rationale: API docs configured from src/bootstrap.ts together with the /api prefix, CORS, and exception handling.

nodes.label: Prisma
nodes.rationale: Database access goes through src/infra/prisma/prisma.service.ts. Runtime reads DATABASE_URL. Prisma CLI configuration is prisma.config.ts and prefers DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED when it is set, for migrations. npm run build generates the Prisma client.

nodes.label: @prisma/adapter-pg
nodes.rationale: Postgres driver adapter Prisma uses in this backend, wired through prisma.service.ts.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.rationale: Redis access goes through the shared RedisService. Some backend end-to-end specs need Redis at 127.0.0.1:6379.

nodes.label: Queue modules
nodes.rationale: Queue modules are registered only when QUEUE_ENABLED is true. Do not assume a queue exists in every environment.

nodes.label: SMS webhook parser
nodes.rationale: src/main.ts installs a bounded SMS webhook parser before general request parsing. Keep that order and any route-specific raw-body handling when editing middleware or webhook controllers.

nodes.label: Stellar
nodes.rationale: Route tests must not submit real Stellar transactions unless a live operation was explicitly requested. Use mocks or validation-only requests. The focused unit suite covers wallet and settlement. This backend skill does not cover Soroban contract work.
